title: Rebind central-factor-packed pins so community-batch952 can admit sou…
body:
> **Duplicate of #4110.** kumagi's [PR #4110](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/4110) repins the same five `central-factor-packed` sources with the same receipt `2aabc7e3…` and was opened first. This PR is an independent reproduction only; reviewers should prefer #4110. See [#1166 coordination note](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/1166#discussioncomment-19056020).

## Change and mathematical scope

Tooling pin refresh. No new κ, no supplier, no selected-frontier change. Selected κ stays `0.001672660197076918`.

`research/central-factor-packed/verify.py` refused current main before any coefficient check. `admit_sources()` still pinned five files from before the #2194 production wiring and the related #2001/#2054 tooling merges. `.github/workflows/community-batch952.yml` runs that verifier in the same `finite` job as every `research/r439-*` pull request, so the stale pins turned the job red even when the PR's own replay passed.

Five live pins in `SOURCES.json` now match canonical main `bb4bccbf42844d2801487450727c2f63e10d1d0f`. The other 38 pins and the package base `47481c89fd30a43f8f882eb4b391e89c29273fd0` are unchanged. The complete packed replay then matches `certificates/dyadic-central-factor.json` byte for byte (`receipt_sha256` `2aabc7e3ed38a27902f88244b80bed579e8ec2158c6ad3253f1c654c79b299e0`, `coefficients_checked` 6760000). That certificate differs from the package's original receipt `ffae0f0a22863718e3134a924592dcf4b05e919223323ba536c587c592bfe6a1` only in three embedded `source_sha256` entries:

- `scripts/exclusion_circuit.py`
- `scripts/experiments/complex_centers.py`
- `scripts/experiments/disjoint_tensor.py`

`scripts/shared_point_circuit.py` also had to be re-pinned; it is not a certificate source. `VALIDATION.json` and `BENCHMARK.json` stay the October 13 record against `ffae0f0a`.

## Task and overlap

- Base: `bb4bccbf42844d2801487450727c2f63e10d1d0f` (canonical `CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds` main; priority revision 6).
- Task: verifier-engineering, responding to the open CI finding on #1166 rather than a new catalogue draw. Scope **refined** to the five drifted `central-factor-packed` pins. The random task picker was not used.
- Finding: https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/1166#discussioncomment-19046528
- Completion posted: https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/1166#discussioncomment-19055874
- Not redone: open #4090 (P112 census `-mpopcnt`, the replay-runtime lever already taken) and `research/central-factor-production/` (the #2194 wiring this refresh admits, not a second algorithm).
- No open PR title matches `central-factor-packed`, `community-batch952`, or `dyadic-central-factor`.

Ordered eligible list used for this session (session 3), after dropping claimed, delivered, and open-PR work, and after dropping the flag-9 head-step repair in #4107:

1. Typed actual-width physical H / rounded return — #1166 comment 19016699 (`uniform-transfer-audit`). Left for another session.
2. Independent review of the tensor-pairing embedding — #1166 comment 19030180 / PR #3928. Left for another session.
3. **This item:** stale `community-batch952` central-factor pins — #1166 comment 19046528.

Priority-table next decisions were ineligible before that list: #3259 review delivered; flag-9 head-step is #4107; joint-query producer work is in open PRs including #3181; selected-stock binding is open #3898; the V45 ledger audit is open #3911; the scatter mutant is open #3801; the `01021323` / L22 prune work is in open PRs including #3821 and #3708.

## Validation

CPython 3.12.3, repository root:

```sh
python3 -B research/central-factor-packed/verify.py
python3 -B research/central-factor-packed/test_packed.py
python3 -O -B research/central-factor-packed/test_packed.py
```

- `verify.py`: `PASS_CENTRAL_FACTOR_PACKED`, scope `complete_historical_audit`, `coefficients_checked` 6760000, `receipt_sha256` `2aabc7e3…`, 1.901 s.
- `test_packed.py`: 11 tests OK in 3.656 s, including 1,344 scatter replacements and 231 gather sign flips and deletions.
- `python3 -O -B test_packed.py`: 11 tests OK in 3.630 s.

Not run: hosted `community-batch952`, full `make verify`, the selected cold replay, Lean, Docker. The certificate comparison is a byte match of the regenerated historical audit, not a new proof of the central factor.

## Credit

Nick Petalas for the CI finding. Ross Richardson for the packed adapter. Wentao Li for the #2194 / #2001 / #2054 production tooling whose bytes these pins now admit. Douglas Colkitt for the dyadic central factor. Prepared by unpaidmoon with substantial Cursor Grok assistance. Apache-2.0. No independent human or formal-kernel review is claimed.

## Open next questions

1. Should `community-batch952.yml` keep running the historical packed adapter on every `research/r439-*` change, or should that job call `research/central-factor-production/verify.py` and leave the historical pins frozen at `47481c89`? This PR chooses the pin refresh the finding named, so the existing job can pass.
2. `scripts/shared_point_circuit.py` is admitted by `SOURCES.json` but is not in the certificate's `source_sha256` map. A later edit of that file will again fail the r439 job without changing the central-factor receipt.

## Workflow feedback (optional)

The account owner posted the completion on #1166 and opened this PR from the fork. Overlap was checked with read-only `gh` searches and the open-PR title list before the pins were edited.
